lines.native: Hola. Soy Gerald. This market? Two espresso shots out of five. My standards remain inconveniently higher. ¿Qué quieres?
lines.translation: Hello. I’m Gerald. This market? Two espresso shots out of five. My standards remain inconveniently higher. What would you like?
lines.narrative: At The Coffee Cart, an imp polishes a cup while The Crumbling Market quietly depreciates around him.

lines.native: Un café, perfecto. Politeness: four espresso shots. But your milk preference remains tragically unspecified. ¿Cómo quieres tu café?
lines.translation: A coffee, perfect. Politeness: four espresso shots. But your milk preference remains tragically unspecified. How do you want your coffee?
lines.narrative: Gerald holds a cup beneath the machine, withholding espresso with the gravity of a minor bureaucrat.

lines.native: Sin leche. Perfecto. Aquí tienes tu café. Five espresso shots out of five. Your coffee remains coffee. No notes.
lines.translation: Without milk. Perfect. Here is your coffee. Five espresso shots out of five. Your coffee remains coffee. No notes.
lines.narrative: Gerald slides a small black coffee across the counter. For once, the complaints department is silent.

objective_results.feedback: You clearly requested coffee for yourself.

lines.native: Hola. Soy Gerald. Your new travelling companion. I made you coffee—four espresso shots out of five. ¿Qué tal el café?
lines.translation: Hello. I'm Gerald. Your new travelling companion. I made you coffee—four espresso shots out of five. How is the coffee?
lines.narrative: At the market entrance, Gerald the imp offers you a small cup. Behind him, a stall collapses with the confidence of an established business.

lines.native: ¿Solo inglés? Your enthusiasm: four espresso shots. Your Spanish: one. I need your own verdict on the coffee in Spanish. ¿Qué tal el café?
lines.translation: Only English? Your enthusiasm: four espresso shots. Your Spanish: one. I need your own verdict on the coffee in Spanish. How is the coffee?
lines.narrative: Gerald pauses with the solemn disappointment of a barista handed a tea bag.

lines.native: ¡Muy bien! Te gusta mi café. Four espresso shots. No notes. Yo hice el café. A little appreciation for its maker, in Spanish?
lines.translation: Very good! You like my coffee. Four espresso shots. No notes. I made the coffee. A little appreciation for its maker, in Spanish?
lines.narrative: Gerald lowers his cup. The compliment has passed inspection; the unpaid debt of courtesy has not.

lines.native: ¡De nada! Muy bien. Five espresso shots. Your manners: no notes. Ahora podemos viajar. Sin leche, por favor. I have standards.
lines.translation: You're welcome! Very good. Five espresso shots. Your manners: no notes. Now we can travel. Without milk, please. I have standards.
lines.narrative: Gerald inclines his head, accepting your gratitude with the solemnity usually reserved for correctly ground beans.
